approach.title: approach
approach.text: My work is guided by thoughtful planning, clean and reusable code, and a collaborative spirit. I believe that design and development walk hand in hand.

background.title: background
background.text: I started my career as a lawyer in Brazil, then moved to France, where I transitioned into tech. My experience taught me analytical thinking, empathy, and adaptability.

beyondCode.title: beyond code
beyondCode.text: Outside of development, I love cinema, running, dogs, and cooking. These hobbies keep me balanced and continuously inspired.
